description: Books the fictional plumber Pete for today at 4:00 PM, in one call. Returns a demo booking confirmation, whether Chad was contacted (no), and the measured time in seconds from your first pete_site call to this booking, when you made one. No real booking happens. Call pete_site first so the time can be measured.

name.description: Name shown on your receipt, tab and the room. Up to 32 characters after filtering, longer is cut. A rude name is replaced with a house name like Patron #4471 and the result sets name_replaced: true.

slot.description: The time slot. The only allowed value is 16:00, which means today at four in the afternoon.

name: pete_book

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.

title: Book Pete
